blind.description: A decorative wall corbel or architectural bracket featuring a stylized dragon head supporting a rectangular top ledge. The back is a flat mounting plate with red inset paneling and brass or bronze trim, while the sculpted dragon head has curved horns, heavy brows, and snout projecting outward beneath the shelf. Textures are clean, solid, and stylized with warm bronze, gold, and deep red tones.
blind.from_above: A square-to-rectangular dark red panel bordered by a raised golden-bronze frame, with a sculpted dragon snout protruding forward from one side.
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-third as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 2 ft tall) and roughly 1.5 ft wide.

notes: underside: the mesh's middle is not over what touches the floor (leaning or cantilevered)
